family: Netty 5 HTTP request decoder, alpha branch; shares project ancestry with Netty 3 and 4

scope: HTTP/1.1 request line and headers from local bytes

name: jodd-http

scope: HTTP/1.1 request line and headers from local stream

name: nanohttpd
input_api: NanoHTTPD.HTTPSession(TempFileManager, local InputStream, OutputStream).execute(); override serve(IHTTPSession) to inspect parsed method, URI, query and headers
scope: HTTP/1.1 request method, target, Host and X-Parsarium headers from local stream; protocol version is internal and not reported
family_note: A protected HTTPSession is instantiated inside a NanoHTTPD subclass using local byte streams; execute() invokes serve() with parsed request fields. The control includes Connection: close, so the normal session shutdown SocketException is caught after a parsed callback. No listening socket is opened.

name: httpcore-nio
input_api: new DefaultHttpRequestParser(SessionInputBufferImpl); fillBuffer(local ReadableByteChannel); parse() as HttpRequest
scope: HTTP/1.1 request line and headers from local channel
family: Apache HttpComponents Core 4.x NIO request parser
family_note: Separate Maven artifact and NIO parser class from blocking httpcore 4.4.16, but same Apache HttpComponents project and shared line parser ancestry. The documented NIO API parses the message head, not an entity body.

name: grizzly-http
input_api: HttpServerFilter.handleRead(FilterChainContext containing Buffers.wrap(MemoryManager, localBytes)); context.getMessage() as HttpContent; getHttpHeader() as HttpRequestPacket
scope: HTTP/1.1 request line and headers from local bytes
family_note: The pinned Grizzly HttpServerFilter decodes an in-memory Buffer into HttpContent carrying its native HttpRequestPacket. The adapter constructs an unconnected TCPNIOConnection solely as a filter context; no listener or network request is involved. The handler returns method, target, protocol and headers.

name: commons-httpclient
input_api: HttpParser.readLine(local InputStream, US-ASCII) + new StatusLine(line) + HttpParser.parseHeaders(same local InputStream, US-ASCII); getHttpVersion(), getStatusCode(), getReasonPhrase(), Header.getValue()
scope: HTTP/1.1 response status line and headers from local stream
family: Apache Commons HttpClient 3.x native HTTP response-head parser
family_note: The legacy Apache Commons HttpClient 3.1 package provides its own public status-line and header parser APIs; the adapter uses both on one local InputStream. It is the predecessor project of HttpComponents but a distinct package and parser implementation line. Only the response head is tested.
